villa-splendore.location: Estate Chocolate Hole and Great Cruz Bay, Saint John, USVI
villa-splendore.description: Renovated in 2016 - all new furniture throughout, appliances, electronics, kitchen appliances, countertops - fans, etc. Located on the ocean side of Maria Bluff with fabulous Western exposure from 375 ft above the ocean ensuring sunsets all year long, great views of St Thomas, St. Croix, the southern cays, all of Pillsbury Sound, and the northern cays. Two identical king suites with A/C and large baths with stunning garden showers. Also an air-conditioned cupola den/bedroom with spiral staircase access and a king or (2) twins with a 1/2 bath on the main level. Pool 10X30 with charming fountain. 9 min drive to town, 12-15 min to North Shore beaches.
villa-splendore.fees: 12.5% hotel tax/5% service charge, $59 non-refundable damage waiver, Pre-paid refundable $1000 damage deposit

southern-exposure.location: Fish Bay, Cruz Bay, St John, USVI
southern-exposure.description: 3 bedroom villa with three baths, located in Fish Bay on the south shore, quick 12-minute drive to Cruz Bay. Upstairs/downstairs layout with two separate communal living areas and large decks. Raised deck pool surrounded by native stone and coral walls with colorful bougainvillea, allemande flowers, hibiscus and palm trees. Panoramic St. John ocean views and trade wind breezes. Second lower-level covered deck for dining off the lower family room. New colossal deck area for grilling and lounging. Master bedroom has private deck.
southern-exposure.fees: 12.5% USVI Hotel Tax, Refundable Security Deposit: $250

seaside-breeze.location: Coral Bay; 25 minute drive to Cruz Bay
seaside-breeze.description: Spacious beachfront villa added to portfolio in May 2021. Built in 2006, not previously offered for rentals. 3700 sq/ft interior, 1740 sq/ft exterior decks. Floor to ceiling windows with two huge trapezoid windows. Coral stone tiled floors, open floor plan, cedar woodwork. Bluetooth enabled audio system with 8 zoned speakers. Insulated (unusual in St. John). Single best feature: location - just steps from sandy beach and 82 degree Caribbean waters. Swim, snorkel, kayak, paddle board from your front yard.
seaside-breeze.fees: 12.5% hotel tax/5% service charge + $400 cleaning fee, $1000 prepaid damage deposit

cinnamon-ridge.description: HGTV Caribbean House of the Year 2020. Elegant 5-bedroom 5.5 bath home with pool and hot tub. Completely renovated in 2019. Gated entrance, tropical walkway. Great room with kitchen, living and dining area looking out to Caribbean views. Two primary bedrooms on opposite sides of great room, each with private en-suite bathroom. Interior staircase to lower level with 3 additional guest bedrooms and en-suite bathrooms. Expansive sun deck with private pool, hot tub, covered seating and wet bar with flat screen TV. Heated pool available ($62/day).
amenities: Outside dining on upper & lower decks
Poolside Bar w/flat screen TV, wine cooler, sink & refrigerator
cinnamon-ridge.fees: 12.5% hotel tax/5% service charge + $450 cleaning fee, $59 non-refundable damage waiver

island-rider.location: Point Rendezvous, south shore of St. John, above Klein Bay
island-rider.description: Fully renovated villa in exclusive Point Rendezvous enclave. Sprawling verandas overlook Rendezvous Bay and Ditliff Point. Beautifully appointed 4 bedroom home with stone work, modern amenities, solar heated pool and spa. State of the art gourmet kitchen, open dining room, separate media room. Four distinct outdoor seating areas: The Veranda, Courtyard, Pool Deck and Lower Spa Deck. 5 minutes from Cruz Bay.

surfside.location: Oceanfront, 15-18 min drive to Cruz Bay
surfside.description: Cathedral ceilings, rose tiled floors, rattan furniture. Stereo/CD player, cable HDTV, VCR, DVD player. Two dining locations with ocean views - interior teak table seats 6, outdoor teak table seats 6. Cook's kitchen with marble countertops, farm sink, stainless steel appliances (4-burner dual-fuel stove, refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave). Gas BBQ on patio. All 3 bedrooms similar size with AC and ocean views - main level queen with French doors to small deck, upper king with small deck, lower king off pool deck. Each with adjoining tiled bath and shower.

rates.in_season_2025: $4,319/wk (2 people) to $5,299/wk (6 people) (Jan 6 - Apr 15, 2025 & Jan 9 - Apr 15, 2026)

surfside.fees: 12.5% hotel tax/5% service charge, $59 non-refundable damage waiver
